answer: Paid work stays gated until a rotating knoll of seven established peers has watched a new key for two epochs. Each hour the recruit must publish a signed relic that binds its latest accepted output to those peers' current checkpoint hashes. Every knoll member also posts a public beacon that lists only the relics it actually received on time. A Sybil farm fails because every fresh key needs distinct live watchers, and a copied or missing relic is visible on the beacon before any payout is released.
